candidates.snippet: South Africa's Bafana Bafana have won four consecutive AFCON Qualifiers games for the first time in their history.

🇬🇭 Ghana losing 2-4 to us doesn't come as a surprise since I follow Ghana's football, says The Gambia's Coach, Jonathan McKinstry.

He said he noticed some Ghanaian Players were unhappy with each other and there was disruption in the team. https://t.co/XyYLQt2pjg
